params.caption: 🎮 Analyst: GTA 6 is what keeps console gaming growing in 2026 A Newzoo analyst says Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to rescue what has been a rough year for consoles. In the analyst's words, "without GTA 6 the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026" — a lot is riding on Jason and Lucia's launch. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 03:35 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @RockstarGames 🎯 Can one game carry a whole market?
